title: ParaView-MCP: An Autonomous Visualization Agent with Direct Tool Use
creator: Liu S.
source_title: Proceedings 2025 IEEE Visualization Conference Short Papers Vis 2025
normalized_title: paraview mcp an autonomous visualization agent with direct tool use
V70_REASON: ParaView-MCP directly controls ParaView and uses visual feedback for closed-loop visualization parameter updates.
